records.title: 本地理念：侏儒购得Bhai Xhou甲
records.description: 本地理念明确1721一名侏儒奇械师购得遗存甲胄，发现能减弱火器冲击但会耗去其中气能；制作法已经失传。这里只采用器物研究叙述，不据此声称He Preahsang在1721仍独立。

dateEvidence.evidenceScope: 本地理念文学与设定叙述；未经独立正史来源确认；不因理念可解锁而证明该年国家存在。

locators.excerpt: While it was no secret that Bhai Xhou armour was exceptional in the mobility it granted the wearer, little was known about its ability to counter gunpowder weaponry. It was only in 1721, when a gnomish artificer purchased one of the few remaining sets that it was discovered the Bhai Xhou could mitigate the impact of many common gunpowder weapons. This appeared to expend the Chi imbued within the set, however, and with the techniques to make the armour lost to time, perhaps the true strength of these mythical armours may never be uncovered.
